_meta.description: 35 criteria (9 sectors x Technology/Regulation/Demand & Economics), the fixed assessment framework for the transition-feasibility assessment. Derived from docs/Transition_Barrier_Assessment.xlsx (Criteria Reference sheet), verified 2026-08-14. This is the join table -- primary_sources[] entries carry url/locator/access_pattern/refresh_cadence where verified. This file is authoritative; data/source_registry.json is a derived flattened view.

criteria.criterion: Levelised cost of renewable generation vs. new-build fossil
criteria.metric: LCOE of utility-scale solar PV and onshore wind (USD/MWh) vs. LCOE of new-build CCGT/coal in the same region

rating_rubric.H: Renewable LCOE at or below new-build fossil LCOE without subsidy
rating_rubric.M: Renewable LCOE within 10-30% of new-build fossil LCOE, or below only with subsidy
rating_rubric.L: Renewable LCOE more than 30% above new-build fossil LCOE

primary_sources.locator: Annual global and regional energy investment tracking by technology and sector
Executive summary PDF gives headline LCOE figures by technology and region

primary_sources.source_name: Lazard Levelized Cost of Energy Analysis
primary_sources.locator: Unsubsidized LCOE ranges by technology, US-focused

criteria.criterion: Grid-scale storage / firming technology readiness
criteria.metric: Deployed grid-scale battery storage capacity (GWh) relative to variable renewable capacity (GW) in the region; TRL of long-duration storage
criteria.unit: GWh storage per GW variable renewables

rating_rubric.H: Storage-to-renewables ratio and grid flexibility sufficient to avoid material curtailment (region-specific benchmark, informed by IEA grid integration studies)
rating_rubric.M: Storage deployment underway but curtailment or grid congestion already material
rating_rubric.L: Storage capacity negligible relative to variable renewable penetration

primary_sources.locator: IEA Energy System tracking page for grid-scale storage; annual data updates within IEA Electricity report

criteria.criterion: Effective carbon price on power generation
criteria.metric: Carbon price applicable to power sector emissions (ETS price, carbon tax, or implicit price via clean energy mandate penalty)

rating_rubric.H: Effective carbon price exceeds USD 60/tCO2 or binding 100% clean generation mandate with penalty
rating_rubric.M: Effective carbon price USD 15-60/tCO2, or clean generation target without binding penalty
rating_rubric.L: No material carbon price or clean generation mandate

criteria.criterion: Renewable deployment target and permitting regime
criteria.metric: Legally binding renewable capacity target (GW or % of generation) by target year; average grid connection queue time (years)

rating_rubric.H: Legally binding target with permitting reform reducing connection queue below 3 years
rating_rubric.M: Target exists (binding or aspirational) but connection queue exceeds 3 years
rating_rubric.L: No binding target, or connection queue exceeds 7 years

criteria.criterion: Corporate and utility PPA market depth
criteria.metric: Annual volume of signed corporate/utility power purchase agreements (GW) for renewable generation in the region

rating_rubric.H: PPA market established and growing; multi-year forward contracting standard practice
rating_rubric.M: PPA market exists but thin or concentrated in few counterparties
rating_rubric.L: PPA market negligible; renewable generation sold predominantly on spot/merchant basis

criteria.criterion: Green hydrogen cost vs. DRI-H2 breakeven

rating_rubric.M: Green hydrogen cost within 2x of breakeven
rating_rubric.L: Green hydrogen cost more than 2x breakeven, or no green hydrogen supply chain present
